title: a fetch step named without a year
line: a citation with no year on a row with no instance, at a holder whose pages carry no identity the attach reads, is named whole: the citation's own record locator sits where a year would, one person's two citations of one collection are two names, and a turn pauses on the page like any other

steps.say: the fetch list's entries at the state marriage index the two grandparents cite with no year, and one person's two citations of the New Jersey index

expect.why: the undated citation's entries are named whole, the citation's record locator where a year would be, each ending in its own person's six characters
one person's two citations of one collection at one holder are two entries under two names
the other citation's name carries its own locator

steps.say: a turn on one of the grandparents pauses on the page, named whole

expect.why: the turn pauses for the browser session: its state is kept
the step stays planned: paused on, not run, not logged
